resources.string: Administer an OpenTAKServer from the map
Server address and the account OTS Admin signs in with
The https:// address of your OpenTAKServer, e.g. https://tak.example.org
An account with the administrator role. Use a dedicated one, so losing this device does not mean losing your own login
Stored in ATAK preferences, which are not encrypted. Treat this device as trusted or do not store it
